title: Great tour

title: Nice tour, Salvatore is an excellent guide.
text:
A wonderful experience!
Salvatore is a super competent and well-prepared guide; the tour flew by and it wasn't the usual boring visit… we were told a lot of interesting facts that we won't forget. The view from the very top of the Giralda is beautiful. A truly beautiful cathedral! I recommend it.
author: StrufiMarra

title: Great tour, learnt so much.
text: Loved the guided tour, we would have missed so much if we had gone on our own. Our guide was very good, super knowledgeable and kept us entertained. Everything worked from start to finish- very satisfied.
author: sean_r

title: An unmissable experience!
text:
The Cathedral is majestic and visiting it is an essential stop if you visit Seville. 
Doing it with a guide who accompanies the beauty to be seen with the eyes with historical references and illustrating what you are admiring makes the experience certainly more complete and exciting.
Our guide Susanna accompanied us with so much professionalism but also friendliness and cheerfulness. Really great!!!
author: sabrina_c

title: An Anazing Tour with Manuel
text: Manuel took his time to explain everything and geared the tour to our specific interests. The tour was very thorough on this amazing site.
author: Robert_M
